title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Onsite Visit Amount
content:
## The visit priced

The visit priced is the one whose resolution milestone (labor class onsite business-hours, labor route invoice) is the latest by its resolution moment in the agreement's ticket history; the service desk platform never stamps two resolutions of one agreement with the same minute. Its resolution milestone supplies the recorded billable minutes. With no such ticket there is no visit to price and the amount is zero.

## The amount

The onsite visit amount of a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket is the recorded billable minutes divided by 60, multiplied by the tier's onsite hourly rate, rounded half up to the cent, plus the tier's onsite trip charge for the wholly billable visit.

The amount is assembled in a fixed order: the values and the method used are fixed first; any percentage reductions are then added into one combined percentage and applied once to the labor, rounded half up to the cent; flat charges are added last.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A visit with 75 recorded billable minutes at an onsite rate of 100.00 and a trip charge of 50.00: 75 divided by 60 is 1.25 hours, times 100.00 is 125.00; plus 50.00, the amount is 175.00. With 60 minutes at 200.00 and a trip charge of 50.00, the amount is 200.00 plus 50.00, that is 250.00.
